name: archpoint-vms
description: ArchPoint Visitors — visitor management for the Arch Point office, Jaipur

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.demo: concurrently -n demo-api,web -c magenta,green "npx tsx backend/src/testing/devServer.ts" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
